files.provenance: Benign-by-construction lead-in of the Splunk attack_data recordings above: for each recording, the events of its busiest host from the start up to 30 s before the first Atomic Red Team harness or attack-tool event (so before any test ran), de-duplicated by event shape across recordings and thinned deterministically to the cap. This is idle Windows Server 2016 domain-controller lab activity (boot, services, Splunk forwarder, .NET compilation by the harness's PowerShell). Splunk attack_data publishes no benign-only dataset, so this is not a production workstation baseline.
